question.text: The National Voluntary Guidelines (NVGs) issued by MCA in 2011 were revised in which year to align with international standards and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)?

explanation.text: The Logic: The 2011 NVGs issued by MCA were revised in 2015 to align with international standards and the Sustainable Development Goals. The SDGs were adopted globally in September 2015, which drove the alignment of the NVG revision. The Trap: 2013 saw the Companies Act; 2018 is the year associated with the separate National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct (NGRBC); 2022 saw the NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE launch. Only 2015 matches the NVG revision year. Note: The 2011 NVGs and their 2015 revision are distinct from the later National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct (NGRBC), 2018 - the workbook treats these as separate milestones.
